data.name: Shirish
data.gender_notes: Shirish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shri’ meaning ‘wealth, fortune’, and the word ‘Rish’ meaning ‘sage or scholar’. The name Shirish symbolizes the wealth and wisdom of a sage or scholar. It is also associated with the rose apple fruit, which is considered auspicious and is believed to bring blessings. The name Shirish carries the meaning “Rose apple” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shirish usually hope their child will grow to embody rose apple and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, names hold deep significance and are derived from various sources. The name Shirish reflects the reverence for sages and scholars in Hindu society. It also reflects the idea that wisdom and knowledge are valuable and precious assets.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shirish holds spiritual significance as it represents the union of wisdom and material wealth. It emphasizes the importance of possessing knowledge and inner wisdom in seeking worldly success and prosperity. Shirish is a name that inspires one to strive for spiritual growth alongside worldly achievements.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Shirish is a name of the Yadav clan god Krishna in his infant form. The name Shirish carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Yadavas were an important community in ancient India and were believed to be the descendants of the legendary king Yadu.

historical_references.reference: Shirish is also a name of the god Shiva in his form as the destroyer of ignorance and the embodiment of purity.
historical_references.context: The worship of Shiva as the god of destruction and regeneration gained popularity during the medieval period in India.
